# GetAnyAPI

GetAnyAPI is an independent API aggregation marketplace at getanyapi.com for discovering and running normalized data APIs. It is not officially affiliated with the source platforms whose public data may be available through its marketplace.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/getanyapi/.
